using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans;
using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.Tests
{
    public class SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>> _mockData;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _mockLoggerFactory;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly GrainId _grainId;
        private readonly SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain _grain;

        public SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests()
        {
            _mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            _mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _grainId = GrainId.Create("test", Guid.NewGuid());

            _mockLoggerFactory
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(_mockLogger.Object);

            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformRead<int>(It.IsAny<Func<GrainData, int>>()))
                     .ReturnsAsync(0);
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<Action<GrainData>>()))
                     .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            _grain = new SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain(_mockData.Object, _mockLoggerFactory.Object)
            {
                // Manually set GrainId for testing since it's protected
                GrainIdInternal = _grainId
            };
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task OnActivateAsync_CallsLogInformationWithCorrectGrainId()
        {
            // Arrange
            string expectedGrainId = _grainId.GetPrimaryKeyString();
            _mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(_grainId.ToString())).Returns(_mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await _grain.OnActivateAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            _mockLoggerFactory.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(_grainId.ToString()), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
                    It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == $"GrainId {{GrainId}}"),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].ToString() == expectedGrainId)
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Set_LogsInformationWithCorrectNewValue()
        {
            // Arrange
            const int newValue = 42;

            // Act
            await _grain.Set(newValue);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
                    It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Setting value {NewValue}."),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].Equals(newValue))
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Add_LogsInformationWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            const int numberToAdd = 10;
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformRead<int>(It.IsAny<Func<GrainData, int>>()))
                     .ReturnsAsync(5); // Current value

            // Act
            await _grain.Add(numberToAdd);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
                    It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}."),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 2 && args[0].Equals(numberToAdd) && args[1].Equals(5))
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }
    }
}

        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _mockLoggerFactory;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain _grain;

        public SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests()
        {
            _mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<Action<GrainData>>()))
                     .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            _mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

            _mockLoggerFactory
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(_mockLogger.Object);
